'''Head of State''', known as the '''Imperial Head of State''', or the '''Galactic Empire Head of State''', was the [[Politics|political leader]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], beginning in [[41 ABY]] at the end of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] had been presiding over the revived Imperial Remnant in the final [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] of the war following the [[Second Battle of Fondor|death]] of [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], but when their opponents in the [[Jedi Coalition]] approached them with an ultimatum&mdash;face war crime trials for the deployment of a [[nanovirus]] of which they had recently approved of the creation, or accept the Coalition as their new allies and force the war's other party, the [[Confederation]], to surrender to their combined might&mdash;the [[Moff/Legends|Moffs]] agreed. The catch was that [[Jagged Fel]], a young [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] whose [[Fel dynasty|family]] had long had Imperial ties, would be installed as the Remnant's new leader in order to keep the Moffs in line. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] made the proposal to the Moff Council without first informing Fel of his intentions, which caught the pilot unaware. He accepted, however, in order to bring an end to the war.<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

Fel led the Remnant for the next several years, and in [[43 ABY]], he visited the Alliance's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to attend a [[Unification Summit]], designed to mend the broken relationships between [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] various major governments.<ref name="Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref> While on the capital, he was the target of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and an [[Lecersen Conspiracy|attempted coup]] by Moff [[Drikl Lecersen]],<ref name="Backlash">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]''</ref> and when he returned to [[Imperial Space]], the power-hungry [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]] also attempted to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him and seize power. Though her plot failed,<ref name="Ascension">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref> public support for her in the Remnant led Fel to call a [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|general election]] and turn the Head of State position into one electable by the Remnant's citizens in a wave of democratic reforms. With Fel's help, Admiral [[Vitor Reige]] won the race.<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
